# `matrix mean` for [filters](/commands/categories/filters.md)

<div class='command-title'>Compute the mean of all elements in a matrix.</div>

## Signature

```> matrix mean {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| matrix | float  |
## Examples

Compute the mean of a 2x2 matrix
```nu
> [[1 2] [3 4]] | into matrix | matrix mean
2.5
```

Compute the mean of an identity matrix
```nu
> matrix identity 2 | matrix mean
0.5
```
